name: Classic VV Difficulty
description: Makes the game play as hard as the classic Virtual Villagers games; off by default. Ticking it ticks all of these: Food Gains are Flat, like VV1-3 (Harder Games), Hungrier Villagers (2-10x Meals), 2-10x Tech Cost, Science Collectibles Only Count When Complete, Harder Fishing Unlock in VV4, Collectible Spawn Timing works like VV1-3, Sickness works like VV1-3 and Difficulty Settings. Set how hard with the two sliders (2-10x Tech Cost and Hungrier Villagers); Owner's Defaults sets both to 2. Unticking any of them unticks this row too, and then the rest stay as they are. This row changes nothing by itself. **Needs all of the patches it names.**
behavior_changes: None of its own: it ticks Food Gains are Flat, like VV1-3 (Harder Games), Hungrier Villagers (2-10x Meals), 2-10x Tech Cost, Science Collectibles Only Count When Complete, Harder Fishing Unlock in VV4, Collectible Spawn Timing works like VV1-3, Sickness works like VV1-3 and Difficulty Settings.
explicit_non_changes: No executable byte, file or save is changed by this row itself.
evidence_status: a selection of other patches; each one's own evidence applies
